corrections.title: Conditional sourceSpelling preserves absent/null/value
corrections.kind: Exact correction to LA-15 record-contract application; source direction unchanged

fields.fieldPresence: absent|null|value. value means a present non-null source value, including an empty string, array or object; do not normalize empty to absent or null.
fields.sourceSpelling: Conditional original JSON value: omit the key for absent; require literal null for null; require the exact original non-null value for value. Never substitute the canonical language ID or spelling.
fields.authority: exact grant/decision that permits the derived effect

constraints: If fieldPresence is absent, sourceSpelling MUST be absent.
If fieldPresence is null, sourceSpelling MUST be present with JSON null.
If fieldPresence is value, sourceSpelling MUST be present with the exact original non-null JSON value, including any empty value.
The sourcePath, sourceSha256, recordId and authority must identify the actual preserved source; a syntactically valid record alone does not authenticate that source.
Canonicalization belongs in derived identity fields and never rewrites this source value.

corrections.title: TI-04 automaton scope and noncombat task-start Action
corrections.kind: Exact correction to LA-14 application, not a change to completed recipes or class cards

affected.old: A crafted device requires an actual authorized capable controller with INT 6+, consent and ten active minutes using actual Tinker's tools and its legitimate accessible interface. No tool proficiency is granted or required merely to use a known functioning interface. An already bound machine requires actual release by its controller or a separately completed lawful control procedure; ownership does not hack unknown, locked or hostile equipment. Commands require the configured visible/audible channel within 60 ft, a Bonus Action on the controller's regular turn, and the shared one-command/one-offensive-output allowance per owner per numbered round across class and crafted systems. Execution follows the controller's whole turn in its attached phase. Failed execution still spends committed allowances; rebinding does not refund them. Fluency, overhearing, an interpreter or a telepathic ally does not supply control authority or undocumented hardware/protocol. Service, repair and controller transfer keep their real histories and costs. A language lesson does not reset them. Class device membership remains separate; TD-08 retains at most two CURRENT Dissonance into ONE own active qualifying device within 30 ft under its actual timing/frequency.
affected.replacement:
**TI-04 controlled automata, not all crafted devices.** A TI-04 automaton requires an actual capable consenting controller with INT 6+ and ten active minutes using actual Tinker's tools at its legitimate accessible interface to register that controller and one compatible simple task. No proficiency is granted or required merely to use a known functioning interface. A previously bound chassis requires actual release by its controller or a separately completed lawful control procedure; ownership does not hack unknown, locked or hostile equipment. A controller may have three active ordinary crafted automata; separately defined special profiles and class devices keep only their own actual limits and exceptions. Traps, manually operated utilities and operator-driven machinery do not acquire this binding or attached-phase protocol merely because they are crafted devices. Use their own arming, direct-operation, activation and servicing procedures.

**In initiative**, an eligible automaton command requires a Bonus Action on the controller's regular turn, the configured visible/audible channel within 60 feet, and the actual shared one-command/one-offensive-companion-or-device allowance per owner per numbered round. Execution follows that controller's whole turn in the attached phase. Failed execution spends committed allowances; transfer, rebinding and extra turns do not refund them. Other item families retain every shared budget that their own controlling procedures expressly apply; this scope correction waives none.

**Outside initiative**, programming or reprogramming one such automaton's actual finite, physically possible noncombat task takes ten active minutes. Do not charge a second programming period for the unchanged task validly registered during initial binding. Starting one already programmed, wholly noncombat task uses an Action, not the combat Bonus Action command. Actual appendages, access, capacity and paid power/service intervals remain necessary. No professional work, autonomous attack, indefinite production or service reset follows from a program or language lesson. Fluency, an interpreter or a telepathic ally supplies neither control authority nor undocumented hardware. Service, repair and controller transfer remain separate and preserve their real histories, costs, HP, charges and custody.

**TD-08 is a separate class-device permission, not limited by this automaton-command scope.** It retains once per short rest, a Bonus Action, and up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The completed source's actually armed charged trap, powered automaton, utility in a live eligible task, or aligned operator-driven device can qualify on its own terms. Merely carrying an idle item does not. Keep the original routing disable, clearance, service and resource histories; no class feature is granted here.

In round 20 that same controller has a regular-turn Bonus Action, a working configured visible channel within 60 feet, and an unused shared command/offensive allowance. In round 20 commit the regular-turn Bonus Action and applicable shared command/offensive allowance. Resolve the instructed automaton action after the controller's whole turn; a blocked execution does not refund committed allowances.
Reject a second class/crafted command for that owner in round 20, an extra-turn refresh, or a telepathic intermediary offered as an undocumented hardware receiver.

After initiative has genuinely ended, and only while the automaton is otherwise operative, spend ten actual minutes to program a new lawful finite noncombat sequence. Start that programmed task with an Action. Do not reset, refund or extend its actual paid power/service interval.
